body:
# 📖 ExpandBook

A lightweight plugin that adds craftable **Expansion Books** — items that increase the world border of specific worlds when used.

## ✨ Features

- Craft books for the **Overworld**, **Nether**, and **The End**
- Each book expands the world border by a configurable amount
- Maximum border size per world is enforced and configurable
- Recipes are automatically unlocked for all players on join
- Fully configurable via `config.yml` — expand amounts, max sizes, recipes, messages, and colors
- Custom world support — add any world to the config and get a book for it automatically

## ⚙️ Configuration

All values are configurable in `config.yml`:
- Expand amount per use
- Maximum border size per world
- Recipe ingredients and shape
- Item name, lore, and colors
- All plugin messages

You can also add **custom worlds** by simply adding a new entry to the config — no code changes needed.

## 📋 Requirements

- Java 21+
